title: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
description: Tata Motors Ltd achieved a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing last year's loss. Revenue from operations rose significantly to ₹23,930 crore, up 42% from the previous year. Improved demand was driven by higher fleet utilization and industrial activity, according to managing director Girish Wagh. Consolidated profit also increased to ₹1,257 crore, aided by a drop in mark-to-market losses.

title: US data centre spending seen more than doubling to $2.1 trillion by 2028, estimates BoFA
description: Global data centre spending is expected to reach $1 trillion in 2026 and more than double to $2.1 trillion by 2028, driven by rising demand for AI services, BofA Global Research estimates. The data centre market could reach $2.93 trillion by 2030 as AI fuels rapid infrastructure expansion.

title: US Treasury yields rise but 10-year stays below 5% as AI jitters persist
description: US Treasury yields rise after a sharp drop in the previous session, but the benchmark 10 year yield stays below 5% as lingering AI market concerns keep investors cautious. Strong economic activity and sticky inflation remain key factors for bond markets, while expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next week weaken further.

title: EAAA India Alternatives mops up Rs 360 crore from anchor investors; IPO opens on Oct 26
description: EAAA India Alternatives has successfully raised approximately Rs 360 crore from anchor investors prior to its IPO. This IPO is set to open for public subscription on October 26. The company will not receive any proceeds from the issue as it is an offer for sale. Prominent institutional investors and major domestic mutual fund houses participated in the anchor allocation.

title: Shriram Finance Q2 profit jumps 59% YoY to Rs 3,677 crore on  strong interest income, lower funding costs
description: Shriram Finance reported a 59.4% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 standalone profit to Rs 3,677 crore, driven by higher net interest income and lower funding costs. Assets under management grew 17%, while the board declared an interim dividend of Rs 6.50 per share.

title: Shree Cement profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 263 crore on higher fuel costs
description: Shree Cement’s September-quarter net profit fell over 15% year-on-year to Rs 263 crore for the third consecutive quarterly decline. Revenue rose 24% and sales volumes increased 14%, but soaring fuel costs pressured profitability despite stronger premium product sales.

title: Jana Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 127%, raises FY27 growth outlook
description: Jana Small Finance Bank reported a 127% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 170 crore, supported by business growth, higher margins and improved gross asset quality. The bank raised its annual profit growth guidance to 100%, while loans and deposits expanded.

title: Jindal Steel Q2 profit rises 21% as revenue hits record Rs 19,448 crore
description: Jindal Steel’s Q2 FY26 profit rose 21% year-on-year to Rs 771 crore, while revenue surged 44% to a record Rs 19,448 crore. Higher steel production and sales boosted earnings, while adjusted EBITDA grew 33% and net debt declined sequentially.

title: BPCL Q2 Results: Net profit declines 21% YoY to Rs 4,863 crore, revenue grows 29%
description: BPCL reported a 21.45% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 4,863.05 crore, despite 29.78% revenue growth. Sequential performance rebounded sharply from a quarterly loss, while the company approved a subsidiary for its proposed Andhra Pradesh refinery.
